high_level_description: This image is a promotional post for a documentary film titled "The Coke Cartel: The Dark Side of Happiness." The poster is predominantly red with a torn paper effect at the bottom, giving it a raw and intense look. The title of the film, "The Coke Cartel," is prominently displayed in large, bold white letters with a distressed texture that adds to the gritty aesthetic. Below the title, the subtitle reads, "The Dark Side of Happiness," which hints at the film's critical perspective on Coca-Cola.
